seed_data_creation: Pytest tests create isolated test databases (test_alloc_{ObjectId}) with test data and clean up after. API tests use existing leagues in production database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 174 verified the expanded game-level scoring allocation system with backfill engine. Key features verified: (1) Stats allocated at game level based on ownership at puck-drop, (2) Earlier earnings preserved after trades, (3) Unowned intervals excluded, (4) Bench/IR periods excluded, (5) Corrections apply to original owner, (6) Recomputation is idempotent, (7) Backfill engine reconstructs ownership from trades/activity_feed/roster_change_log, (8) Fallback path flags uncertain results when no backfill has been run. Test files: /app/backend/tests/test_game_allocation.py (18 unit tests).
